cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Fair Exchange
cards.instruction: Price every favor in time, effort, inconvenience, or future obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll scrub that pan for two shopping trips. Remember when I taught you to bargain? Here's your chance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've counted the pans. Now price the dried cheese. Two trips.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One trip, then. You're finally improving your offer. Bring detergent as well; negotiation doesn't wash it.
